process_parallelism.measurement: single process, single worker, no parallelism applied

projection.formula_w_workers: wall_seconds(W) = mean_seconds_per_candidate * 4824000 / (W * efficiency(W)), with efficiency(W) <= 1 and unmeasured here
limitations: the canary samples a handful of decision states, not the generation distribution over families, team sizes, policies and timesteps
rollout length dominates cost and varies with the decision timestep: a late decision state continues for fewer intervals than an early one
larger teams cost more per interval; the canary covers N in {5,6,8,12} and never N=16 or N=24
no parallel efficiency was measured, so any W-worker figure is an upper bound on throughput rather than a prediction
the measurement is single-process on one machine with no I/O, serialization or job-scheduling overhead included

records.selector_error: local action search has no eligible robot-local candidate

selection_rule: deterministic predeclared diagnostic cases: several team sizes among the allowed non-N24 set, four scenario families, a collision-prone counterfactual and a case where the safety projection changes the pre-safety action
